Crm (A)/1130/2024 on 12 April, 2024
 12.04.2024
 Sr. No. 92.
 Ab
 Court 28
 [Allowed]
 C. R. M. (A) 1130 of 2024

In Re: An application for anticipatory bail under Sectio  the Code of Criminal Procedure in connection with Daspur  Station Case No. 571 of 2023 dated 13.10.2023 under Sect  498A/302/304B/34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sect  3 /4 of the D. P. Act  In Re: Sk. Jabbar Ali & Ors. ... ... Pet

Mr. Amitava Karmakar,
 Mr. A. K. Bhowmick ... ... for the Petitioners.

Mr. Saibal Bapuli, ld. APP,
 Md. Aqib Badr ... ... for the State.

Md. Zohaib Rauf,
 Mr. Arpit Choudhury .......for the Defacto c  1.
Heard the learned lawyers for the parties.
2. Petitioners are the in-laws of the victim lady.
Principal accused, that is the husband, has been enlarged on regular bail.
Allegations of torture are not supported by the grandparents in whose house the victim had committed suicide.
3. Under such circumstances, we are of the opinion, custodial interrogation for progress of investigation is not necessary and the petitioners may be granted anticipatory bail.

4. Accordingly, we direct that in the event of arrest, the petitioners, namely, Sk. Jabbar Ali, Lali Bibi @ Laili Bibi and Sk. Amir Ali @ Sk. Rajesh Ali be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/-each, with two sureties of like amount each, to the satisfaction of the arresting officer Signed By :
APURBA BANDYOPADHYAY and also subject to the conditions as laid down under High Court of Calcutta 16 th of April 2024 11:58:49 PM Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 and they shall appear before the court below and pray for regular bail within four weeks from date.
CRM (A)/1130/2024 on 12 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/67365231/
1 5.
The application for anticipatory bail is, thus, disposed of.

(Gaurang Kanth, J.) (Joymalya Bagchi,
J.)
